passing_score.verbatim: Before you can be a licensed driver, you have to pass two exams.

exam_facts.note: Handbook section 1.12 (physical p32) states two exams (Driving Knowledge Exam, then Driving Skills Exam), that the knowledge exam must be passed first, and that the skills exam must follow within two years. Full-text searches for pass/percent/questions/correct/score found no question count, passing score, passing percent, or time limit anywhere in the guide; all are null as genuine absences, not imported from memory. Printed numbering is section-style (1.12), not page numbers.
